exceptions.name: org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on
exceptions.reason: Not reachable from ApprovalVerifier: it calls math.ec.rfc8032.Ed25519.verify with raw fixed-length keys/signatures and bounded message bytes, with no certificate or PKIX name-constraint parsing. Upstream fix 2c28b25 changes PKIXNameConstraintValidator. This exact-version review covers the approval plugin only, not other Besu certificate/TLS uses; 1.84 is supplied by the pinned Besu runtime, not bundled by this plugin. Reassess on crypto API, trust-key format or host-version changes; see SECURITY.md.

exceptions.name: org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on
exceptions.reason: Not reachable from ApprovalVerifier: raw Ed25519 verification uses byte decoding, curve arithmetic and SHA-512, with no ASN.1 parser. Upstream fix 77454da changes the lazy ASN.1 sequence parsing depth guard. This exact-version review covers the approval plugin only, not other Besu ASN.1 uses; 1.84 is supplied by the pinned Besu runtime, not bundled by this plugin. Reassess on crypto API, trust-key format or host-version changes; see SECURITY.md.

exceptions.name: com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core
exceptions.reason: Not reachable through the approval extension on pinned Besu 26.8.1: its IPC parser uses JsonFactory.createParser(InputStream), and HTTP uses Vert.x Buffer/String decoding, not createParser(DataInput). PrepareApprovalRpc accepts one raw-transaction String from getParams() and decodes hex/RLP; CanonicalJson is a handwritten output encoder. The plugin bundles no Jackson classes and cannot update the parent-first host library. This exact-version review covers approval ingress and RPC only, not other Besu Jackson/DataInput uses. Reassess on RPC/parser, host-version or serialization changes; see SECURITY.md.

exceptions.name: com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core
exceptions.reason: Not reachable through the approval extension on pinned Besu 26.8.1: PrepareApprovalRpc reads Object[] parameters without numeric coercion, requires one raw-transaction String, and uses hex/RLP decoding. It never converts arbitrary strings to floating-point numbers, invokes JsonNode.asDouble(), or calls NumberInput.looksLikeValidNumber(); its response uses known strings, booleans and collection values. Approval delivery is bounded protobuf and fingerprint JSON uses CanonicalJson. The plugin bundles no Jackson classes. This exact-version review does not clear other Besu methods or host uses; reassess on parameter/coercion, serialization or host-version changes; see SECURITY.md.

exceptions.name: zstd
exceptions.reason: Not reachable in ops-reth-approvals (Reth 2.5.2): zstd's raw with_context is called only by its own read::Decoder::with_context and write::Encoder::with_context, which no linked crate calls; every stream owns its context, and tower-http builds a new ZstdEncoder for each RPC response. Reassess on Reth, tower-http, async-compression or direct zstd usage changes.

exceptions.name: zstd-safe
exceptions.reason: Not reachable in ops-reth-approvals (Reth 2.5.2): the experimental feature compiles StableInBuffer, but no linked crate sets it; the only compression parameters set are CompressionLevel and tower-http's WindowLog, which it sets only at levels of 17 and above while Reth uses the default level. Reassess on Reth, tower-http, async-compression or direct zstd usage changes.

exceptions.name: zstd-safe
exceptions.reason: Not compiled into ops-reth-approvals (Reth 2.5.2): zstd-safe's seekable module is gated on the seekable feature, which no dependency enables (zstd-safe features on x86_64 and aarch64 Linux: arrays, experimental, legacy, std, zdict_builder). Reassess if `cargo tree -e features -i zstd-safe` shows seekable, or on Reth upgrade.

exceptions.name: zstd-safe
exceptions.reason: Not reachable in ops-reth-approvals (Reth 2.5.2): the only OutBuffer::around_pos caller is compression-codecs 0.4.38 zstd/mod.rs (tower-http RPC response compression), over a compression-core WriteBuffer rather than a Vec; async-compression builds a fresh WriteBuffer on every poll and the position only advances through set_written_and_initialized_len, so it never passes initialised memory. Reassess on compression-codecs, compression-core, async-compression, tower-http or Reth upgrade.

exceptions.name: zstd-safe
exceptions.reason: Not reachable in ops-reth-approvals (Reth 2.5.2): the experimental feature compiles CCtx::init_using_cdict and DCtx::init_using_ddict, but no linked crate calls them; dictionaries are attached through ref_cdict/ref_ddict in zstd's bulk Compressor/Decompressor (reth-zstd-compressors, nippy-jar). Reassess on Reth or direct zstd usage changes.

exceptions.name: zstd-safe
exceptions.reason: Not reachable in ops-reth-approvals (Reth 2.5.2): one-shot DCtx::decompress and CCtx::compress2 run only on zstd bulk Compressor/Decompressor contexts (reth-zstd-compressors, nippy-jar) that never stream; reth-codecs uses the public TRANSACTION_/RECEIPT_COMPRESSOR thread-locals only through compress()/decompress(), no linked crate calls Compressor::context_mut, and every streaming encoder or decoder owns its own context. Reassess on Reth or direct zstd usage changes.

exceptions.name: zstd-safe
exceptions.reason: Not reachable in ops-reth-approvals (Reth 2.5.2): train_from_buffer is reached only through zstd::dict::from_continuous in nippy-jar Zstd::prepare_compression, which is #[cfg(test)]; from_samples has no callers, and runtime compression uses the prebuilt reth-zstd-compressors dictionaries. Reassess on Reth or direct zstd usage changes.

exceptions.name: zstd-safe
exceptions.reason: Not reachable in ops-reth-approvals (Reth 2.5.2): no linked crate calls CCtx::try_clone, and no multithreaded context can exist: the bundled zstd 1.5.7 in the Docker image and CI-built binary is compiled without zstdmt and without the pkg-config feature or ZSTD_SYS_USE_PKG_CONFIG, so it lacks ZSTD_MULTITHREAD and rejects NbWorkers != 0. Reassess if zstdmt, the zstd-sys pkg-config feature or ZSTD_SYS_USE_PKG_CONFIG is enabled, or on Reth upgrade.

exceptions.name: zstd-safe
exceptions.reason: Not reachable in ops-reth-approvals (Reth 2.5.2): the live decompress_stream callers are zstd::stream::read::Decoder (Reth's download command extracting an operator-chosen snapshot, and nippy-jar static files), which the advisory lists as unaffected; there is no write::Decoder caller and no decompression layer, since reqwest's decompression features are off and reth-downloaders uses only gzip. Reassess if reqwest or Reth enables zstd decompression, or on Reth upgrade.

exceptions.name: zstd-safe

exceptions.name: block-buffer
exceptions.reason: Not affected in 0.10.4: OSV's range is a blanket introduced 0 to fixed 0.12.1 without per-version analysis. The advisory's mechanism is the 0.11/0.12 inline cursor stored inside the block bytes and overwritten before a panicking compress/gen_block callback. 0.10.4 has no inline cursor storage and no ReadBuffer: its cursor is a separate pos field, written only after callbacks return, so a caught panic leaves a valid position. No 0.10.x fix exists (digest 0.10.7 requires 0.10); the 0.12 copy is updated to the fixed 0.12.1. Reassess on any block-buffer or digest version change.
